description: Replace the raw service key login with a username/password form and add quick-action buttons for creating new city/coworking/service articles in the admin panel.
steps: Rewrite AdminLogin.jsx with username + password form that validates against env vars (VITE_ADMIN_USERNAME / VITE_ADMIN_PASSWORD) with defaults admin / emo@2026. On success, check VITE_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY env var; if set store in sessionStorage and redirect, otherwise show secondary service key input.
Update .env.example to include VITE_ADMIN_USERNAME, VITE_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and VITE_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY with explanatory comments.
Add quick-action buttons to AdminArticles.jsx for Add City Article, Add Coworking Article, Add Service Article that link to /admin/articles/new?type=city etc.
In AdminArticleEditor.jsx, read the ?type query param on mount and pre-fill page_type from it.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes successfully with exit code 0
AdminLogin shows a username/password form instead of a single key input
After login, if VITE_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY is set, user goes straight to /admin/blog
If VITE_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY is not set, user sees a secondary service key prompt
AdminArticles page has quick-action buttons for each page type
AdminArticleEditor reads ?type query param and pre-fills page_type
verification: Run: export PATH=/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/emo-websitenew && npm run build
findings: Build passes with 398 prerendered pages. AdminLogin now has a two-step flow: (1) username/password, (2) optional service key if VITE_ADMIN_SERVICE_KEY env var is not set. Quick-action buttons added with color-coded styles (emerald for city, purple for coworking, amber for service). AdminArticleEditor reads useSearchParams for ?type pre-fill.
